entries.speaker: Challenge Battle High Scores
entries.en: Challenge Battle scores are based on the [clr 2]amount of[n]damage dealt[clr 27]. Therefore, dealing massive damage[n]will help you obtain a high score.

entries.speaker: Challenge Battle High Scores
entries.en: Use abilities such as [clr 2]Support Skills[clr 27], [clr 2]Baton Pass[clr 27],[n]and [clr 2]Technical[clr 27] in order to obtain a high score.[n]Bonus effects will give you an even higher score.
